test_name: Verify Navigation to API Documentation and Endpoint Exploration
description: Tests the user's ability to navigate to the API documentation page and explore API endpoints by scrolling through the content.
steps: Locate the 'roost.ai' logo link in the header.
Ensure the page redirects to https://dev.roost.ai/docs/api.
Verify the API documentation page is loaded successfully.
Scroll through the API documentation content.
Identify and verify the presence of multiple API endpoint details.
Scroll to the bottom of the page and ensure all content is visible.
expected_results: User is successfully redirected to the API documentation page.
All API documentation content is visible and accessible.
User can scroll through and view all API endpoints.
edge_cases: The API documentation page does not load.
The link to the API documentation is disabled or broken.
The page content does not render correctly.
API endpoint details are incomplete or missing.
data_requirements: Valid API documentation content available on the page.
Network connectivity to load the documentation.
Functioning navigation link to the API documentation.
Complete set of API endpoint details.
dependencies: The API documentation page is deployed and accessible.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the API documentation page.
Rendering speed of API endpoint details.
accessibility_requirements: All interactive elements have appropriate ARIA labels.
Content is navigable using a keyboard.
Page structure is semantic and follows WCAG guidelines.
